title: Real Time Account Updater
applicability: Applies to card-not-present Segment 100 transactions from a participating acquirer/merchant that are Credential-on-File, Installment, or Recurring payments.

businessRequirements.title: Real Time Account Updater applies only to card-not-present transactions from a participating, registered/certified acquirer/merchant that are Credential-on-File, Installment, or Recurring payments.

A participating merchant shall send the Account Updater Request Indicator (Segment 111, Table ID 060, Sub Table ID 01) as the trigger on Installment, Recurring, and Credential-on-File request messages.
Real Time Account Updater processing depends on Account Number (Element 2) and Card Discretionary Block Data (Element 12) content and shall be validated jointly with those fields.

testCases.positive: Non-participating merchant omits the indicator; card-present transactions are out of scope
negative: Indicator sent on a card-present transaction
Indicator sent by a non-registered merchant

testCases.positive: Table ID 060 Sub Table 01 present on Installment/Recurring/COF request with valid Account Number/Card Discretionary Data
negative: Indicator missing on an eligible transaction
